say:1:1620831001:1.text: First, each of you needs to pick a character.
say:1:1620831001:1.source_cn: 首先，你们需要选择各自在本次故事中所要扮演的身份。

say:2:1620831002:1.text: Choose one of the four cards before you. These four characters will appear in the "Dungon & Hypogeans" story.
say:2:1620831002:1.source_cn: 你们面前有四张角色卡，均是根据《魔与地上城》的故事背景...

say:4:1620831003:1.text: You remember the original title was "Dungons & Dagons"... Has Contess tweaked the plot?
say:4:1620831003:1.source_cn: 你记得那个故事的原名是《龙与地上城》……康缇丝修改了模...
say:4:1620831003:1.male: You remember the original title was "Dungons & Dagons"... Has Contess tweaked the plot?
say:4:1620831003:1.female: You remember the original title was "Dungons & Dagons"... Has Contess tweaked the plot?

say:5:1620831004:1.text: Anyway, let's play it by ear.
say:5:1620831004:1.source_cn: 总之，先看看她打算怎么玩这场游戏吧。
say:5:1620831004:1.male: Anyway, let's play it by ear.
say:5:1620831004:1.female: Anyway, let's play it by ear.
